0.original: Uin Nee is anxious about their dealings with the Nu Mou.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

24.original: Survey the designated location north of Phisor Lran and slay a sweet echevore for its tail.

25.original: Deliver the echevore tail to Uin Nee.

48.original: Well, if it isn't my favorite mortal! And do you know <hex:021A020203>why<hex:021A020103> you're my favorite? Why, it's because you have a knack for showing up <hex:021A020203>precisely<hex:021A020103> when I need something done. Like now, for example!

49.original: You see, I've asked a Nu Mou crafter to craft me a delightful new toy to bring to the children in their dreams, and I promised I'd repay them with something very, very special─an echevore tail, to be precise!

50.original: Have you ever seen an echevore tail? You can smell them or sip from them, and they have the taste and aroma of sweet, sweet honey! A bit <hex:021A020203>too<hex:021A020103> sweet for my liking, to tell the truth, but the Nu Mou just can't seem to get enough of them.

51.original: But there's a bit of a rub. The sweetest of the sweet echevores can only be found distressingly close to the stamping grounds of those oh-so-nasty Fuath. Just imagining being gripped in those slimy, slippery, slobbery hands makes me─ick! Why did you make me think such unpleasant thoughts!?

52.original: Hmph! As penance, I demand that you go forth and fetch the echevore tail that I seek! And if you see any Fuath along the way, feel free to smack them in their smarmy faces with those stupid little hats of theirs!

53.original: <sniff> Is that sweet, sweet honey I smell? I knew you wouldn't come back empty-handed! Well, hand it over then, already!

54.original: Why, I say, this is the sweetest aroma I've ever had the pleasure of smelling! Perhaps those Nu Mou <hex:021A020203>do<hex:021A020103> know what they're talking about. Perhaps they won't mind if I take just a teeny-tiny smidgen...

55.original: Ahem! Which is to say, of <hex:021A020203>course<hex:021A020103> I'm not thinking of taking a sip! We pixies have <hex:021A020203>far<hex:021A020103> more refined palates than those silly Nu Mou. We're not ones to sit around all day sucking on these icky tails!

56.original: At any rate, thank you as always for being so subser─er, helpful! So helpful! Please come back again soon! Now, just a tiny little... Hmm? You're still here?
